title: Reserve spend before dispatch and reconcile provider-reported usage
goal: VC-201-052 claims spend is reserved before the request and reconciled against provider-reported usage afterward, across parallel agents. The ledger itself is real, atomic and well tested: SpendPolicy, Reservation, BudgetLedger::reserve, commit(res, actual), release, global() and reserve_dispatch, whose own doc comment says it reserves 'right before dispatch'. But reserve_dispatch (crates/susi-gawd-agents/src/cloud_budget.rs:290) has no callers anywhere in the tree, commit and release are called only inside the module's own tests, and nothing consumes provider-reported usage - no reported_usage, provider_usage or actual_usage symbol exists outside tests. So no request reserves before it is made and none reconciles after.
